# DOT Hazmat Function Specific Training: Placarding

> 2-hour online function-specific training for hazmat employers and employees who select and display placards for hazardous materials on motor vehicles, rail cars and bulk packagings, under DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR Part 172 Subpart F. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 2 hours; 2 modules, 3 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.2 CEU
- Price: $39.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years (recurrent training at least every three years, and when relevant regulations change)

## Topics
- General placarding requirements
- Differences between package labels and placards
- Affixing primary and subsidiary placards; subsidiary hazards that must always be placarded
- Placard design, size, color and form
- Bulk packaging, transport provisions and exceptions
- Special provisions for highway and rail; application to vessel and air
- Recognizing placards for each hazard class and division

## Lessons
1. Regulatory Overview
2. General Placarding Requirements
3. Specific Placarding Requirements

## Who should take it
Hazmat employers; shipping and receiving staff; warehouse workers preparing placarded freight; carriers; safety managers.
